name: Spine JSON (4.3)
description: Spine JSON in the 4.3 shape: one `constraints` array tagged by `type`, `inherit` on bones, `rgba` slot timelines, `value` on bone rotate keys, and curve control points in absolute time/value. Written from Esoteric Software published format documentation and an observed 4.3 export; no Spine runtime source and no other editor exporter was read. Partial by design - see docs/export-spine.md for what does not cross.
